nodes.label: LocalDateType
nodes.rationale: MikroORM writes Date in UTC (forceUtcTimezone); a system date after 21h would shift to next day, so date columns store the local day. date_of_birth stays 'date' since it arrives as UTC midnight.

nodes.label: MikroORM RequestContext middleware
nodes.rationale: Isolated EntityManager per request to avoid context leaks and concurrent transaction collisions.

nodes.label: Timezone America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires (process.env.TZ)
nodes.rationale: Parity between reservations, price validity, shifts and DATETIME columns without UTC drift.

nodes.label: Price versioning (ParkingPrice, ServicePrice)
nodes.rationale: Prices are never overwritten: old gets expirationDate, new inserted with startDate, keeping past invoices consistent.

nodes.label: parkingSeeder (idempotent by name)
nodes.rationale: Runs on already seeded DBs: fills province/neighborhood, creates missing spaces up to capacity (R-18), deletes $0 prices.

nodes.label: reservationSeeder
nodes.rationale: Assigns employee 1 to Estacionamiento Central Plaza and seeds client 1 (AE123CD) history once with invoiced reservations (R-14).

nodes.label: Business constants (PLANNING_HORIZON_MONTHS, ACTIVE_RESERVATION_STATUSES)
nodes.rationale: Numbers are not repeated in code; they live in src/Shared/constants/.

nodes.label: catchAsync
nodes.rationale: Avoids repetitive try/catch in controllers by forwarding rejections to next(err).

nodes.label: checkAvailability (temporal overlap)
nodes.rationale: Crosses requested range against active reservations by vehicle type to prevent overbooking.

nodes.label: createPublicUserSchema
nodes.rationale: Public registration restricted to CLIENTE or DUENO; ADMIN/EMPLEADO not selectable.

nodes.label: errorHandler (global middleware)
nodes.rationale: Maps AppError to status, unique violations (ER_DUP_ENTRY) to 409, hides stack on 500 in production.

nodes.label: progress.txt (append-only log, Codebase Patterns)
nodes.rationale: Learnings help future iterations avoid repeating mistakes.

nodes.label: Argentine address model (province required)
nodes.rationale: Province is mandatory because localities share names across provinces.

nodes.label: 409 with details.conflicts (shifts/holidays)
nodes.rationale: Lets the frontend offer to transfer affected reservations.

nodes.label: Local unversioned tests policy (_test databases)
nodes.rationale: Tests run with tsx against MySQL only on *_test DBs; after pull/merge, run tests and classify failures as regression vs outdated test; never delete or skip a test to pass.

nodes.label: Module layout: Entity/Schema/Repository/Service/Controller/Route
nodes.rationale: Business rules live in the service; routes only validate with validateSchema (zod).

nodes.label: shortcut: L-xx debt comments
nodes.rationale: Shortcuts must match open rows in the owner notes so debt stays tracked.

nodes.label: One story per iteration loop
nodes.rationale: Pick highest-priority failing story, implement, pass quality checks, commit, mark passes:true; stop with <promise>COMPLETE</promise> when all pass.
